item.name: Havoc Rune
item.maxEffect: Scales with rune level up to Lv. 50
item.description: The highest flat damage rune in the game. Havoc Rune provides the strongest raw damage multiplier of all runes, making it the recommended first rune for new players and endgame builds alike. Added in the Huge Update (March 10, 2026) and confirmed as the Best Rune by official Discord FAQ.

stats.scaling: Highest flat damage bonus of all runes (scales with rune level up to Lv50)

item.name: Primordial Rune
item.source: Infinite Tower (Tower Island): less than 1% drop rate from Tower floors. Level 8,500+ required.
item.dropNote: Less than 1% Infinite Tower drop listed locally
item.description: +112% DMG max (Lv.60) — the highest damage bonus rune in Sailor Piece and the best in the S+ tier. Primordial Rune is a Secret rune added in the Massive Update (March 25, 2026), dropped exclusively from Infinite Tower floors at less than 1% chance (Level 8,500+ required). Surpasses Havoc Rune as the top DPS rune. A drop bug was fixed at launch (19:22 March 25). Source: Beebom runes guide (2026-03-26).

stats.scaling: +84% DMG (base Lv.1) → +112% DMG (max Lv.60). Source: Beebom runes guide (2026-03-26).
stats.location: Infinite Tower (Tower Island) — less than 1% drop rate from Tower floors. Level 8,500+ required.

item.name: Wrath Rune
item.description: A powerful flat damage bonus rune. Wrath Rune scales from +40% DMG at base to +59% DMG at max level, making it a reliable and versatile damage option for all builds.

item.name: Fortune Rune
item.description: The only luck-boosting rune in the game. Fortune Rune scales from +10% Luck at base to +15% Luck at max. Essential for farming builds since Luck is a rare and hard-to-stack stat.

item.name: Radiant Rune
item.source: Infinite Tower (Tower Island): rare drop from Tower floors. Level 8,500+ required.
item.dropNote: Infinite Tower rare drop listed locally
item.description: A Secret rune added in the Massive Update (March 25, 2026), obtained exclusively from the Infinite Tower. The Radiant Rune provides a Luck bonus, improving drop rates for rare items across the game — complementing Primordial Rune which focuses on damage. Exact max value is +26% Luck at max level. Source: Beebom runes guide (2026-03-26, provisional).

stats.scaling: +26% Luck (max Lv.60) [Provisional — awaiting Discord confirmation]. Source: Beebom (2026-03-26).
stats.location: Infinite Tower (Tower Island) — rare drop from Tower floors. Level 8,500+ required.

item.name: Destruction Rune
item.description: A solid damage rune providing a flat damage bonus. Destruction Rune scales from +25% DMG at base to +37% DMG at max. A strong alternative to Wrath Rune.

item.name: Inferno Rune
item.description: Applies a burning DoT to enemies on hit. At max level, Inferno Rune deals 104% of total damage over 4 seconds, a solid sustained DPS option for boss fights.

stats.scaling: Base: 70% total DMG over 4s → Max (Lv50): 104% total DMG over 4s

item.name: Blood Rune
item.description: Inflicts a bleed effect on enemies, dealing damage over 5 seconds. Blood Rune scales from 65% bleed damage at base to 97% at max level. Longer duration than Inferno Rune but slightly lower total damage.

stats.scaling: Base: 65% total DMG over 5s → Max (Lv50): 97% total DMG over 5s

item.name: Frost Rune
item.description: Freezes enemies on hit while dealing bonus impact damage. At max level, Frost Rune freezes enemies for 3 seconds and adds 44% DMG — a strong crowd-control option for PvP.

stats.scaling: Base: 30% DMG + Freeze 2s → Max (Lv50): 44% DMG + Freeze 3s

item.name: Guardian Rune
item.description: A defensive rune providing an HP bonus. Guardian Rune scales from +39% Max HP at base to +59% Max HP at max level. Useful for tank builds but outclassed by damage runes in most scenarios.

stats.scaling: Base: +39% Max HP → Max (Lv50): +59% Max HP

item.name: Suppression Rune
item.description: The weakest rune, providing minor damage reduction. Suppression Rune scales from 10% to 15% DMG Reduction. Outclassed by all other runes for most builds.

stats.scaling: Base: 10% DMG Reduction → Max (Lv50): 15% DMG Reduction
